items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: That's where I worked with Alberta Hunter and Pete Newton.

ctx.x: For Oklahoma. How long did you stay in Oklahoma?

Oklahoma? Things were happening so fast. I don't think I was in Oklahoma no longer than -- not a year at all. Because after Oklahoma, I went to Dallas. Dallas, Texas, with a band called Don Purcell. We were playing at Aven Pap's. That's where I worked with Alberta Hunter and Pete Newton.
